finish.summary: Compact 4-cell desk unit built with half-base drawer and mount spike with small platform at the central 3-way corner. Verified meshClash clear, capped and locked.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Compact build verified. Desk staging on top shows use.

**Requirements:**

* **Compact desk unit** – met. 3 full bases + 1 half base footprint (~4 cells), 1 storey high, with caps and joints secured.
* **Drawer** – met. Half-base at 0,1,0 (piece:0,1,0;half-n) with drawer:0#0,1#cut on its cut face.
* **Spike at corner where three bases meet** – met. Mount spike spike:0#0,0|1,-1|1,0 at junction of pieces 0,0,0 / 1,-1,0 / 1,0,0 (the only 3-way corner in this cluster, verified by find_sockets).
* **Spike holds small platform** – met. Platform-sm accessory set on the mount spike (setSpikeAccessory platform-sm). Mount variant required to trap platform; solid spike rejected and replaced.

Built with house rules (capOpenFaces, lockJoints) and light desk dressing (pencil-cup on drawer rim) to show purpose; meshClash clear, no prop warnings.
